scope: Complete this bounded CPU screening batch for development qualification; not an exhaustive census or formal test set.
reviewer: Codex source and diff review; upstream execution claims have not been independently reproduced
assignment: Sort CPU candidates within repository by SHA256(seed + newline + root_cluster); take round-robin in canonical repository priority. Remaining candidates are development-only reserves. Do not change seed after outcomes.
replacement: Before model evaluation only: record qualification failure and take next reserve in the same repository, otherwise canonical round-robin. Never replace based on model repair success.
unreviewed_rule: Retrieved PRs without a deep review stay deferred, never counted as ineligible or GPU-ready.
shared_pending_gates: Reconstruct original repository checkout and pin a reproducible environment; declarations are archived, installed dependency lock is not complete.
Write an issue-only task specification without solution hints; upstream PR bodies, gold source and regression tests are investigator-only.
Freeze owning modules from before-source public issue/stack and call graph; provisional module lists are not permission to expose gold localization.
Validate public API, supported input domain, independent oracle and visible/hidden partition; both edit interfaces must express a valid fix.
Verify full input context and actual response framing fit budgets; current token audit measures compact JSON of complete modules only.
Run unfixed and official-fix controls in three fresh GPU processes, relevant repository preservation tests and supported memory checks.
Confirm actual repository dispatch reaches intended GPU kernel with no forbidden replacement; no reduced-only task may enter the primary endpoint.
Complete copy/backport lineage and contamination review before any formal test sealing. All selected and reserve tasks in this batch stay development-only.

reviews.reason: Per-token upstream weights are applied after reduction over tokens, losing information needed for weight/bias gradients.
reviews.trigger: reduction=none with nonuniform positive, zero and signed per-token grad_output; bias on/off.
reviews.oracle: Independent PyTorch linear plus cross_entropy and autograd on identical inputs; compare loss and all requested gradients.
reviews.preservation: Original mean/sum paths, uniform upstream gradient, ignored labels, frozen weight, bias absent, FP32/FP16/BF16 within declared support.
reviews.risk: Original module fits 6144; official fixed response is larger but fits 8192. Higher-level host work is legitimate only while preserving existing custom CE path. Shares CE dependency with old #1490, so development-only and never counted as fresh formal evidence.

reviews.reason: Static maximum of 32 silently drops later attention-residual blocks and leaves part of backward output unwritten.
reviews.trigger: More than 32 blocks, starting with upstream N=40; test 31/32/33 and other supported counts independently.
reviews.oracle: Independent depth-softmax weighted-sum reference and autograd for inputs/query/norm weights.
reviews.preservation: Original <=32 cases, odd feature dimensions, all output gradients initialized, supported dtypes.
reviews.risk: PR author explicitly did not run GPU controls. Merge is provenance, not verification. Larger counts may hit compiler/resource limits.

reviews.reason: Equality falls into the negative gradient branch, violating the zero-at-tie subgradient convention of the public reference.
reviews.trigger: All or some p==q entries, including zero padded vocabulary entries; mixed unequal entries as controls.
reviews.oracle: 0.5 * abs(p-q), using the explicitly stated PyTorch zero subgradient at equality; not a claim of a unique mathematical derivative at the kink.
reviews.preservation: Untied entries, reductions, ignored labels, original loss values and declared dtypes.
reviews.risk: Upstream reduction=none tie test does not exercise backward. Expanded contract and exact zero checks required.

reviews.reason: Backward derives hidden size before flattening spatial dimensions, underallocating dx for 4D/5D input.
reviews.trigger: (2,6,4,8) with 3 groups and a 5D input; compare 3D unaffected baseline.
reviews.oracle: torch.nn.GroupNorm with shared weights and gradients; supported memcheck on the original repo call.
reviews.preservation: 3D input, group=1, group=channels, nonaligned spatial sizes, dx/dw/db shape and finiteness.
reviews.risk: Illegal writes can corrupt a process, so each before control must run in a fresh subprocess. #999 is a separate pointer-refactor PR with no demonstrated bug trigger and is not another task here.

reviews.reason: Probability-space mixture underflows and produces log(0) and NaN loss terms.
reviews.trigger: Finite low log probabilities around -120 and a large vocabulary with one dominant entry; both standalone and fused path.
reviews.oracle: Independently reviewed FP64 log-space mixture and gradients, rather than only the modified upstream test reference.
reviews.preservation: Ordinary probabilities, supported beta endpoints, ignored labels, gradients, vocabulary tails and dtype tolerances.
reviews.risk: Ascend and cuTile changes are the same root fix and not extra defects. Only NVIDIA Triton owner is in provisional edit scope; non-NVIDIA source is retained as provenance.

reviews.reason: Casting GEMM output to FP32 after low-precision storage cannot recover logits precision and harms near-cancelling gradients.
reviews.trigger: Same-dtype BF16/FP16 inputs and projection weights on supported NVIDIA hardware; nearby student/teacher distributions.
reviews.oracle: FP64 projection and independently reviewed loss/gradient reference on small shapes; compare errors with dtype-specific fixed tolerances.
reviews.preservation: FP32 path, older-API fallback as declared, mixed-dtype/autocast support, forward and weight/input gradients.
reviews.risk: Requires supported torch.mm out_dtype and compute capability. This is a host-to-GPU precision-contract repair, not evidence of writing a new CUDA kernel. Related #1397 is a different failure mechanism; quarantine both to development.

reviews.reason: ReLU-square forward/backward and x_prev backward stores access lanes outside the logical tensor tail.
reviews.trigger: Small/non-tile-multiple tensor sizes, including guarded storage tails; evaluate public channel-mixing forward and backward.
reviews.oracle: Independent PyTorch channel mixing and gradient reference plus canary storage and supported memcheck.
reviews.preservation: Tile-aligned sizes, sequence first-step behavior, original supported layouts/dtypes, input mutation and all gradients.
reviews.risk: Several missing tail masks in one module are one bundled PR/root cluster, never several independent n. Shared tests/conftest.py changed too; do not silently apply unrelated test behavior to before controls.

reviews.reason: Two related token-parallel kernels call a host helper from a JIT kernel, rejected by the documented Triton 3.6 execution path.
reviews.trigger: Invoke original KDA and GDN2 token-parallel launchers under a supported pinned Triton version that rejects this construct.
reviews.oracle: Compilation plus independent small-shape numerical reference; compile success alone is insufficient.
reviews.preservation: Dense/varlen inputs, K boundaries, both launchers and relevant existing chunk tests.
reviews.test_clue: tests/ops/test_kda.py and tests/ops/test_gdn2.py; PR references issue #1106
reviews.risk: Upstream regression runs used Triton 3.4, not the failing 3.6. Must establish supported-version before/fix control locally. Both copied occurrences count once.

reviews.reason: Sort narrows int64 values/sentinels to int32, changing ordering; related dtype helper adjustments belong to this single task cluster.
reviews.trigger: Int64 values outside int32 range, odd/padded sort widths, ascending/descending.
reviews.oracle: torch.sort/argsort with the public tie/stability contract and exact integer comparison; topk preservation.
reviews.preservation: Supported small integer and floating types, tie permutations per API, topk dtype extrema, non-last dimension where supported.
reviews.test_clue: Upstream issue #505; no regression test added by this PR, existing test discovery recorded in archive.
reviews.risk: Need independently constructed trigger and original repository tests. Int8 helper and sort changes are not counted as two independent defects.

reviews.reason: addmm treats a broadcastable matrix bias as a single row.
reviews.trigger: Bias shape (M,N) with distinct rows, plus (M,1), (1,N) and scalar where publicly supported.
reviews.oracle: torch.addmm and FP64 alpha*(A@B)+beta*bias on small inputs with fixed tolerances.
reviews.preservation: Vector/row bias, signed alpha/beta and beta=0 behavior, transposed inputs, shape validation.
reviews.risk: Older repository snapshot and Triton APIs require a compatible environment. Expanded beta=0/special-value contract must be checked on official fix before sealing.

reviews.reason: Autotune can choose BLOCK_SIZE smaller than N, leaving most of each row outside the norm reduction and scaling stores.
reviews.trigger: N=640 with a legal smaller block and an original entrypoint run; p=2/3 and maxnorm=1.
reviews.oracle: Independent p-norm row clipping and torch.renorm; check aliasing required by the inplace API.
reviews.preservation: N below/equal/above blocks, varied dim and maxnorm, unaffected functional renorm, declared dtypes.
reviews.risk: Autotuning choice is hardware-sensitive. Freezing a legal tuning choice is an auxiliary trigger; primary eligibility still requires original repository entrypoint reproduction, not a synthetic failure-only launch.

reviews.reason: FlashAttention wrappers pass unsupported noncontiguous layouts into the existing custom kernel.
reviews.trigger: BHSD/BSHD views from model-style projection/transpose for Q/K/V; exercise both public wrappers.
reviews.oracle: Small-shape FP64 attention formula and separately reviewed SDPA reference; original kernel dispatch must remain active.
reviews.preservation: Already-contiguous inputs, causal flag, supported dimensions/dtypes, output metadata and input nonmutation.
reviews.risk: Explicit cherry-pick of #6667: canonical cluster is issue5896 and includes both PRs, count once. This is a wrapper/layout repair and should be reported separately from kernel-body edits.

reviews.reason: Input preparation writes the same first-block query indices repeatedly for sequences spanning multiple tiles.
reviews.trigger: Sequence length larger than BLOCK_SIZE, mixed batches and nonzero query prefix offsets.
reviews.oracle: Exact integer arange per sequence using cu_query_lens; call original prepare-input path.
reviews.preservation: One-block sequences, block-1/block/block+1, ragged batches, untouched output regions.
reviews.test_clue: Issue #15908; no test changed in PR, existing test files probed in source archive.
reviews.risk: Small kernel is promising, but kernel-only repro is insufficient. Original Eagle caller must be exercised without loading an impractically large model or silently replacing integration.

reviews.reason: CUDA-graph padding sentinel -1 is used as a state-cache address.
reviews.trigger: Mixed valid and -1 ssm_state_indices, initial/final state paths and graph replay where supported.
reviews.oracle: Independent valid-sequence recurrence and state-canary checks; padded lanes follow an explicitly stated public contract.
reviews.preservation: Nonnegative indices, non-inplace state path, accepted-token offsets, state noncorruption and repeated replay.
reviews.test_clue: Issue #31186; PR reports four-GPU Qwen3-Next serving repro, no unit regression added.
reviews.risk: High integration risk: only retain if original repo call path can reproduce on one GPU without substituting a reduced-only benchmark. FLA-derived code requires lineage review; missing padded cache index guard is distinct from gate-tail masks.
